name: Brandmeisterin Löschschluss
personality: Can organize an emergency faster than she can admit she needs a rest.
visual_intent: tall top-heavy ink pear, red firefighter helmet with little brass crest, two subtle lashes, one goo hand holding compact speaking trumpet at flank and other planted on goo hip; broad lifted brow, gritted internal two upper teeth, exhausted determination
biography: Can organize an emergency faster than she can admit she needs a rest. She divides HyperNorm emergencies into contained and awaiting containment. Her speaking trumpet struggles when a dissonant card describes something worth saving on both sides of the line. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Einsatz ist geordnet. Die Erschöpfung bleibt vor Ort.

name: Schlauchwart Knickfrei
personality: Trusts water completely and hoses only provisionally.
visual_intent: broad flat-bottom rounded splat, brass retro fire helmet, short coiled red hose with brass nozzle clearly connected; wide uneven eyes following nozzle down, tiny toothless worried triangular open mouth
biography: Trusts water completely and hoses only provisionally. He coils the HyperNorm hose according to a diagram that contains no bends. A dissonant card asks whether the water has seen the diagram. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Schlauch gilt als knickfrei, sofern unbewegt.

name: Axtträger Offenjetzt
personality: Regards every locked door as a discussion that has gone on too long.
visual_intent: lean curved hook-shaped blob, small dark leather fire helmet, single short chunky fire axe held vertical beside body; one hooded eye one raised brow, closed sideways toothless sneer
biography: Regards every locked door as a discussion that has gone on too long. His axe opens HyperNorm doors labelled permanently closed. A dissonant card points out that an open doorway can still be a boundary. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Türöffnung ersetzt vorläufig die Aussprache.

name: Maschinist Drucksache
personality: Can hold the pressure steady while everything else becomes approximate.
visual_intent: round drooping blob in navy cap, tiny yellow collar tabs, compact pump-pressure gauge connected to ONE short shutoff valve; huge ivory eyes looking inward at dial, open oval mouth with one upper tooth
biography: Can hold the pressure steady while everything else becomes approximate. His dial divides HyperNorm pressure into correct and regrettable. A dissonant card sits precisely between the marks and refuses to explode. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Druck ist im Rahmen. Der Rahmen ächzt.

name: Rettungsmann Ganzruhig
personality: Lends his calm to anyone who has temporarily misplaced theirs.
visual_intent: square-ish broad splat, plain yellow fire helmet, one compact rescue rope loop held at side; eyes bright and determined, broad crooked toothy smile with two upper teeth, no external tongue
biography: Lends his calm to anyone who has temporarily misplaced theirs. He sorts HyperNorm rescues into safely returned and not safely returned yet. A dissonant card asks why rescue should require the correct address. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Ruhe wird leihweise zur Verfügung gestellt.

name: Funkerin Nachalarm
personality: Hears the next emergency in the silence after the last one.
visual_intent: low lopsided asymmetrical blob, small red fire helmet with goggles parked high, two subtle lashes, chunky handheld radio and short dark scarf; droopy skeptical lids, closed toothless zigzag mouth
biography: Hears the next emergency in the silence after the last one. Her radio announces every HyperNorm incident as either resolved or somebody else's department. She hears the frightened breathing between those categories. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der nächste Alarm ist vorsorglich bereits mitgehört.
